scope: The eight files named as next by B19/M42: the four CMS units (cms_att, cms_dd, cms_io, cms_kem) and the four context units (core_bio, dispatch, mod, thread_data). Three ordering/lifetime defects in src/context/mod.rs repaired against the authority; the other seven files audited with no change. No new unsafe operation, FFI symbol, allocator coordinate or repr(C) layout introduced.
worktree: source: src/context/mod.rs only (decoder store/cache teardown order, child-provider slot position, default-DRBG release, stale module note). src/cms/{cms_att,cms_dd,cms_io,cms_kem}.rs, src/context/{core_bio,dispatch,thread_data}.rs audited with no source change. queue/receipt: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 48 and this file.

reconciliation.method: AUDITED-FILES.txt is the union of each mechanism sweep's structured .files array, the M1 files, the structured per-file records and each boundary sweep's structured boundaries. The eight audited files were removed from REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and inserted at their alphabetical positions in AUDITED-FILES.txt.
reconciliation.difference_from_383: M43 moves exactly the eight named ordinary files; no file is skipped or substituted.

file_dispositions.note: The property flags, the ONLY_ONE duplicate probe and the REQUIRED_COND arm match cms_att.c:213-273 exactly. Every wrapper forwards to the shared x509 attribute stack helpers; no ownership crosses this unit.

mechanisms: ossl_cms_DigestedData_create item allocation and ownership hand-off
ossl_cms_DigestedData_do_final EVP_MD_CTX_new/free pair and verify/encode arms
file_dispositions.note: The fresh EVP_MD_CTX has one release on every arm. Verification checks mdlen against the decoded digest length before reading the digest data, so the two slices are in-bounds; the comparison itself is the authority's memcmp, and mdlen is nonzero for every digest this crate exposes.

mechanisms: PEM_read/write_CMS and BIO forms through d2i_void_cms/i2d_void_cms
BIO_new_CMS and the two streaming wrappers
file_dispositions.note: The void-pointer adapter functions restate the typed encoder/decoder contract. The two extern delegates resolve to the landed asn1::asn_mime no_mangle exports. CMS_stream stores the ASN1 OCTET STRING data field address exactly as cms_io.c:18-35 does and raises the authority's ERR_R_CMS_LIB.

mechanisms: kem_cms_decrypt cipher fetch and wrap-mode check
kem_cms_encrypt KDF default query and AlgorithmIdentifier packaging
file_dispositions.note: Every acquisition (EVP_CIPHER_fetch, ASN1_TYPE_new, d2i_X509_ALGOR) is released on each arm. EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_type is a macro over EVP_CIPHER_get_type(EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get0_cipher(ctx)), so the expanded call is exact. The X509_ALGOR_copy/set0 failure arms match the authority, including the direct return 0 in the set0 arm.

mechanisms: BioCoreGlobals CtxDestroy (empty member body) and CRYPTO_zalloc seam
seven BIO-method forwards through the per-libctx dispatch table
BIO_new_from_core_bio handle adoption and up_ref failure
file_dispositions.note: Reuses OB-3: the block is a CRYPTO_zalloc at bss_core.c:32 and the slot free is the bare block release at :27. The NULL b_bio_free and NULL up_ref guards are the module's already-recorded safety divergences; the authority faults on those paths, so no reachable result changes.

The Sync claim is scoped to static, fully initialised, never-mutated tables, which is what every authority dispatch array is. entry_function refuses a NULL table/entry and a signature whose size differs from a data pointer; lookup's NULL-table answer is the recorded divergence.

mechanisms: OsslLibCtx OB-3 owner and CRYPTO seam coordinates
context_init ordered slot construction and failure unwind
default context RUN_ONCE, thread-local default and set0_default
file_dispositions.note: Three defects repaired: decoder_cache/store order, child-provider slot position versus the provider store's P1 rule, and the default-DRBG leak. The stale module note claiming ossl_ctx_thread_stop is not called was corrected. Slot construction order and the index registry already matched the authority.

mechanisms: OsslLibCtxThreads OB-3 owner (two counters, mutex, condvar)
file_dispositions.note: The slot is claimed before spawn and returned on spawn failure; join decrements before signalling under the same lock. The constructor's failure arm releases both primitives and the unpublished block, matching internal.c:113-157.

defects_repaired.defect: decoder_cache was released before decoder_store; context.c:251-260 releases decoder_store first.
defects_repaired.repair: Swapped the two releases to the authority order.

defects_repaired.defect: child_provider globals were freed before the provider store, inverting the authority's P1 rule. provider_deactivate_free reaches slot 18 through OSSL_LIB_CTX_CHILD_PROVIDER_INDEX; the early free plus re-NULL silently skipped the parent up-ref/free callbacks.
defects_repaired.repair: Moved the slot-18 release to the authority's low-priority position after the thread slot. No UAF existed because the slot was re-NULLed, so this is a behaviour/resource defect.

defects_repaired.defect: The live function (reached from ossl_rand_cleanup_int) stored NULL into slot 5 without freeing the RAND global that Phase 9 now installs, leaking the global and its owned DRBGs.
defects_repaired.repair: Restored the authority's free-then-clear with a NULL guard.

new_unsafe_assumptions.note: The three repairs change release order and add one already-owned release; they add no unsafe operation. Every remaining unsafe expression in the batch has an existing explicit SAFETY contract.

contracts_reused: B1/B2/B6-B18 callback reentrancy contracts for dispatch-table callbacks

batch.default_parallel_note: An unconstrained cargo test --lib run was flaky in runtime::secure's secure-heap init ordering (16 failures). Both required thread counts pass; the flake is the known isolation issue, outside this batch's files, and was not introduced by these edits.

not_run_gates: BOUNDARY independent closure audit of the OsslLibCtx destructor body (changed body requires re-adjudication; zero-state sweep and BATCH rerun pass)
Miri (no component in the court toolchain)
authority differential for teardown side effects (no harness reaches a child-provider teardown)
negative control for M43-R3 (freeing the process-global default DRBG would poison the suite)
